method.cache: Fresh context and Network.setCacheDisabled for every page
method.sampleCount: One cold visit per route/profile; three rounds of four warm queries per profile
method.workerTiming: Native Worker postMessage to corresponding message event; includes startup/fetch/parse for cold request, messaging + search for warm request
method.renderTiming: input event to MutationObserver seeing committed query in search status; includes React scheduling and DOM update, not paint or real-user INP
method.labLimit: Single-host lab diagnostics; field p75 and production budgets remain unverified
method.budgetSource: docs/prompt-library-website-design.md §16.1: field p75 LCP<=2500 ms, INP<=200 ms, CLS<=0.1; initial JS approximately200 KiB, first-screen images approximately600 KiB; no numerical search-index/latency budget
